action.command: cd /tmp && for u in mod@consul.dev verified@consul.dev valuator@consul.dev; do rm -f cj2.txt; T=$(curl -s -c cj2.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); R=$(curl -s -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=$u" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"); UID=$(curl -s -b cj2.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -o 'data-current-user-id="[^"]*"'); echo "$u login=$R $UID"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && for u in mod@consul.dev verified@consul.dev valuator@consul.dev; do rm -f cj2.txt; T=$(curl -s -c cj2.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name=\"authenticity_token\" value=\"[^\"]*\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value=\"//;s/\"//'); R=$(curl -s -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode \"authenticity_token=$T\" --data-urlencode \"user[login]=$u\" --data-urlencode \"user[password]=Aa12345678\"); UID=$(curl -s -b cj2.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -o 'data-current-user-id=\"[^\"]*\"'); echo \"$u login=$R $UID\"; done", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Verify role user logins"}
